name: Setoku MCP tools
description: The tool surface of a Setoku box. Which tools a session actually sees depends on its token's role: an analyst may read the lake but cannot commit knowledge; a curator may commit knowledge but cannot read the lake.

roles.analyst: Reads data and curated context. May only propose knowledge changes.
roles.curator: Commits curated knowledge. Cannot read the data lake.
roles.janitor: Drafts and auto-rejects pending corrections. Commits nothing.

tools.name: find_context
tools.title: Find context for this connector's data (verified + unverified)

tools.name: describe_entity
tools.title: Full context doc for one entity

tools.name: upsert_context
tools.title: Create or update a knowledge doc (generate/curate workflows)

tools.name: draft_correction
tools.title: Attach a drafted doc-edit to a pending correction (auto-draft)

tools.name: run_query
tools.title: Run a read-only SQL query (capped + audited)

tools.name: app_guide
tools.title: How to build a Setoku app (read before publish_app / update_app)

tools.name: publish_app
tools.title: Publish a live app to the box (team-shareable URL)

tools.name: update_app
tools.title: Edit an app you published (in place, same link)

tools.name: list_apps
tools.title: List apps published to the box

tools.name: get_app
tools.title: Inspect an app — its full template + panels (how it's built)
